notes.title: Play for free: Lava Lama Arena
notes.content:
Christmas is coming!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018782/0b4fa1260e04ce3fd111d33c4b8d36a795f77596.png[/img]



As a little gift you can play our small local-multiplayer fighting game Lava Lama Arena.

 [url=https://metellus.itch.io/lava-lama-arena] CLICK HERE TO PLAY IN BROWSER [/url] 

The game was made during a 2-week gamejam.
No download needed, you can play in your browser.

Have fun and and a wonderful christmas.
Cheers!

notes.title: Kick Them Out!!! - permanent price decrease!
notes.content:
From now on you can grab [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/873280/Kick_Them_Out/]Kick Them Out!!![/url] for only a third of the price at release.
This price decrease is permanent.

Also check out the Bundle [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7404/Kick_the_Kingdom_Achievement/]Kick the Kingdom Achievement[/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018782/ddce176e90dd384a0da651b8cdb4fd3f0f64dc22.jpg[/img]

Max
